scope: Post-hoc numeric input matching from 20 completed native captures: 14 primary64 and 6 diagnostic128. Pilot and historical regression captures are excluded.
isolation: Ground-truth fixture declarations, native poses, cooked fingerprints and routes are used only for evaluation/control matching here. No physical fixture geometry is supplied to the RGB-D planning world by this reduction.

hash_methods.json: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators and allow_nan=False
hash_methods.npy_member: SHA256 of the complete uncompressed .npy ZIP member, including its stable dtype/shape header; stdlib ZIP streaming only, no NumPy or geometry processing
hash_methods.occupied_mask: SHA256 of a C-order byte mask computed from uint8 states bytes:1 for OCCUPIED(state2),0 otherwise; grid bounds/dimensions match
hash_methods.original_canonical_arrays: Original producer hash from occupancy.json across states, probabilities, observed, last_observed and expired. Different absolute last_observed clocks prevent full-array identity even when states/probabilities match.

camera_reference.layout: A_current authored scene; no EYES/set_viewpoint override
camera_reference.qualification: Native metadata are exactly consistent across 20 captures and the scene file hash is unchanged in both run receipts. No separate USD-to-camera extrinsic recomputation is claimed by this JSON-only review.

cooked_geometry_reference.qualification: All 11 cooked vertex and triangle hashes match across 20 captures. Full hashes including body_from_mesh match exactly in every GT/B pair and every between-budget comparison. The 2 v43 Home-posture captures differ from 18 START captures only in 10 moving-body transform hashes; the measured maximum transform component difference is 2.220446049250313e-16. Base transform hash is unchanged. These are numerical transform differences, not identical full hashes globally.

fixture_matching_method: The pose-array field does not record rigid-view prim order. For at most 2 fixtures, associate native before poses bijectively to protocol centers by minimum total Euclidean error; check the same full pose array after execution, and corroborate names/centers/dimensions against the separate GT evaluation snapshot. Empty scenes have no added fixture and zero drift by convention.

free_route_comparison.qualification: Only exact same seven-joint start, validated joint goal, joint order and full target are compared. Route identity can disprove obstacle-induced route change; route difference alone cannot establish physical obstruction or safety.

conclusions: All 20 camera calibrations/resolutions and all 11-body cooked vertex/triangle hashes match exactly. Full cooked fingerprints including body_from_mesh transforms match within every comparison pair; v43 differs from START captures by at most 2.220446049250313e-16 in transform components.
GT/B execution-trial initial states and fixed validated IK goals match exactly in all 10 scene/budget pairs. All 6 cross-budget comparisons also match exactly.

Occupied masks, all occupancy states and probabilities match across every paired and cross-budget comparison. Full canonical array hashes differ; last_observed clock fields differ, while observed/expired flags are compared separately.
Narrow64 executes using a frozen RGB-D world, but its GT and RGB-D RRT routes are exactly the same two-waypoint route as empty GT. It is not demonstrated obstacle-induced global detouring.

Large has the same start as empty but a different selected IK goal (maximum joint difference 0.07036803643709116 rad); v43 has different start and target. Their route differences cannot be treated as exact-endpoint comparisons against this empty reference.
limitations: Fixture pose stability checks compare native before/after endpoints and the full physical-world signature; this artifact does not independently rescan every intermediate physical pose.
Failed RGB-D plans can be configured with the identical validated joint candidate without ever reaching IK/search after base preflight rejection; candidate-call counts distinguish these cases.

Matching inputs do not establish complete perception, physical route safety, continuous collision freedom or obstacle-induced detouring. Physical validity and execution outcomes remain separate reports.
